Messages.Author: Mikael Hallin
Messages.Body:
Here's a couple of nifty things for ally decks:

Shadow Court Satyr(changeling):
give him an earth meld/majesty, and he'll always strike: combat ends.
give him a thrown sewer lid and IR goggles and he'll always manouver to long
and hit for 3R.
give him a theft of vitae and he'll steal 1 blood, which gets him a life.
give him a burst of sunlight, it does 1R aggravated damage to all _vampires_ in
combat(effectively turning him into a cheaper order of hermes cabal).

Talaq, the Immortal:
Can use theft of vitae or burst of sunlight, and has a free manouver.

Other weird combos:
Mind of a child + disguised flamethrower rushing.

Malkavian Madness Network + homonculus + fun actions, examples below:
accounting/govern, bring out vampires fast.
the embrace, bring out lots of new small vampires fast.
bleed your prey every turn.
vote every turn.
fifth tradition when the vamp is running low on blood.

example of above combo:
Malkavian Madness Network in play, Greger Anderssen recruits a homonculus.
Greger untaps in his preys turn, and plays superior pulse of the canaille.
Greger untaps in his grandpreys turn, and bleeds his prey.
Greger untaps in the next methusela's turn, and fifth traditions himself.
Greger continues to untap and bleed every turn, or fifth when he's running low
on blood.

There's more weird combos out there... have fun.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
> AFAIR LSJ said it's still in combat since the Bloodhunt is called
> immediately. You couldn't play reactioncards if it was outside combat
> though. Hmm LSJ answer this?

The bloodhunt is not combat. Combat cards cannot be played during a
bloodhunt. The bloodhunt is not an action. Reaction cards cannot
be played during a bloodhunt.
